for: SBDC AI directors and the people who run AI at their center
badge: SBDC AI Admin Kit · MIT licensed
files_step: Get the files: everything is in the public GitHub repository. Click the green Code button, then Download ZIP. No GitHub account needed.
files_panel:
Start here — you just got this kit. Do these three things, in order.

  1. Convert your GPTs. If your ChatGPT workspace has the one-click GPT migration, use it; migrating everything and keeping what people actually use is fine. No button, or moving to Claude? Use the GPT to Skill guide below.
  2. Check every result before advisors touch it. Score it against STANDARD.md (ten pass/fail lines), then run it cold in a fresh chat with TESTING.md. This is the step that matters. Here's why.
  3. Give staff a one-page guide for each skill — like the one below. A plain document works; the kit's generator builds pages like this if you want it.

Everything else in the kit is optional. Written for Maryland and points at Neoserra — check anything that touches your own CRM, programs, or reporting rules before you lean on it. MIT and unsupported — fork it, change it, don't wait on me.
chatgpt_fallback: paste the skill text into a ChatGPT Project's instructions.
